data.content_ref: inline:The target names 'sharing the mechanism of single-number-per-side allocation,' but this phrase is a restatement of the arithmetic (792 digits / ~2.64 digits per page ≈ 300), not a genuine causal mechanism that connects 07e5ec535396 to its neighbourhood. Saying the two endpoints 'share' the same allocation rule does not establish a dependence, reduction, or inheritance relation between them; it merely asserts that both use the same convention, which is a compatibility claim so thin it collapses into a summary of the endpoints. The target fails to state what the mechanism IS in causal terms (e.g., how the digit sequence is generated from the page-numbering process such that 792 digits necessarily yield 300 pages) and instead labels the shared convention as the mechanism.
